scan_log.found: THREE upgrade candidates with hard evidence, all PARKED rather than applied because none could be built and verified inside the remaining budget, and an unverified upgrade is worse than none. (1) A PAPER-BOUNDS GATE. qa.py cannot see the drawn sheet, so DOM text below it renders on the dark desk at 2 to 3 to 1 and passes clean. This run shipped that defect four separate times and the scorer capped the deck at 6.9 for it. The fix is a render-time bounding-box pass asserting every text node sits inside the slide's declared on-paper band and overlaps no other label. This is the single highest value change available to this machine. (2) PDF TEXT EXTRACTION. poppler-utils is absent, so the fact-checker downloaded two government and academic PDFs and could read neither, losing all three Alaska sources. pypdf is already installed and recovered it in one command. Add a pdf_text helper and give the fact-checker a path to it. Government sources are the tier the bank needs most and are disproportionately PDFs. (3) SOURCES.YAML IS STALE ON ACCESS. bizjournals, Becker's, RAND, HousingWire, Pharmacy Times and North of 60 all returned 403 or empty this run. sources.yaml rates bizjournals as the best ground for named mid-market operators and it returns nothing. Either find a fetch path or downgrade its billing.
scan_log.applied_or_parked: parked, all three, with evidence. See out/2026-07-25/restock_notes.md and knowledge/FIELD_NOTES.md.
